appDescription: Find dog-friendly outings, send a verified place to in-car navigation, and track car rides with a dog.

function.name: GAERANG_FIND_PLACES
function.description: Find places compatible with the active dog profiles in Gaerang Narang.

indoor.description: Whether to require indoor dog access for cafes.

function.name: GAERANG_NAVIGATE
function.description: Send a place from the latest Gaerang Narang search to navigation, optionally with a compatible dog-friendly cafe.

placeId.description: Identifier returned in the previous search results.

choice.description: One-based number of the place selected by the user.

addCafe.description: Append the nearest cafe with confirmed indoor access for the active dogs when requested.

function.name: GAERANG_START_RIDE
function.description: Start dog ride tracking in Gaerang Narang from Park.

function.name: GAERANG_FINISH_RIDE
function.description: End dog ride tracking in Gaerang Narang from Park.
